en: Pītisahagataduka (The Pair on Being Accompanied by Rapture)
Dependent on a state not accompanied by rapture (*napītisahagata*), a state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … three.
Dependent on a state not accompanied by rapture, a state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition … three.
Dependent on a state both not accompanied by rapture and not accompanied by rapture, a state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; ... pe ... in the case of the prenascence and repetition conditions, there are six; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, there are nine.
